basis: Independent reference for DEL-04-11 hanger-sizing arithmetic: R-3, R-3b and the arithmetic part of R-4/R-4b, from DEL-04-11. SI units (N, m, N/m). Every position is measured from the installed position u = 0 along the candidate's positive DOF axis; a variable spring set to F_cold carries F(u) = F_cold - k*u. design_index is 0-based into u_operating_m. Inputs are the exact rational values of the decimals (or stated fractions) in the generator; every result is computed exactly with fractions.Fraction and emitted rounded to the nearest binary64. Fit tests, selection, tie-breaks and verification tests are decided on exact rational values; boundary-equality cases use inputs exactly representable in binary64, and the generator confirms that every discrete outcome is unchanged when each input is replaced by the exact value of its emitted binary64 number. Every value is invented; no supplier catalogue or standards data is used. Sizing-time variation lists are never null: sizing forms no ratio with a non-positive reference, because V0 fails the record first. In a verification block, an entry of the variation list is null where the verified reference load is not positive (F_i^v <= 0 under operating_load): no ratio is formed for that case, V0 reports it, and V is judged only on the ratios that are formed (DEL-04-11).

cases.description: Hot design, nonzero u_C = 2 mm, operating-load variation, allowance 1 mm. F_cold = W + k*u_D = 1120, F_C = 1100, F_D = 1000, F_2 = 1200, span [-8, 12] mm, required travel 22 mm, envelope [990, 1210] N.
Cold design, nonzero u_C = 2 mm, design-load variation, allowance 1 mm. F_cold = W + k*u_C = 1020, F_C = 1000, F_D = 900, F_2 = 1100, envelope [890, 1110] N.
Hot design, nonzero u_C, design-load variation: both cases vary by k*10 mm / W = 0.1.
Cold design, nonzero u_C, operating-load variation: v = 100/900 and 100/1100.
Entirely downward travel, hot design, zero allowance: u_C = -2 mm, u_D = -12 mm. F_cold = 880, F_C = 900, F_D = 1000, span [-12, 0] mm, required travel 12 mm, envelope [880, 1000] N.
Entirely downward travel, hot design, allowance 1 mm: required travel 14 mm, envelope [870, 1010] N.
Linear model (u_C = 0) under cold design, zero allowance: F_cold = W = 1500, F_1 = 1200, operating-load variation 0.25 below a limit of 0.3.

Multi-case governing, hot design on case 0 (+10 mm); case 1 (+25 mm) governs variation and the envelope's low end, case 2 (-5 mm) widens the span. VS-STIFF fails V on case 1, VS-NARROW fails L on case 1's end (1830 < 1900), VS-SHORT fails T (34 mm > 32 mm) only because of case 2; VS-FIT fits.
E1 first: a record with no stiffness, a library-1.0.0-style record with no working load range, and a record with no travel range all fail E1 (count 3); VS-OK fits.
E2 first: VS-UX would otherwise fit but its stiffness DOF is UX, not the candidate's UZ; VS-OK fits.
V0 first through F_C <= 0: hot design, u_D = 0, u_C = +1/64 m. VS-6400 gives F_C = 100 - 6400/64 = 0 exactly (it would also fail L); VS-3200 gives F_C = 50 and fits.
V0 first through F_i <= 0: cold design, u_C = 0, cases at +1/128 m (design) and +1/32 m. VS-6400 gives F_2 = 100 - 200 = -100; VS-1600 gives F_2 = 50 and fits with design-load variation 0.5.
L first, low side: envelope [1000, 1100] N, VS-LLOW's F_min is 1001.
L first, high side: envelope [1000, 1100] N, VS-LHIGH's F_max is 1099.
T first: required travel 10 mm, VS-T's travel range is 9 mm.
V first: VS-V (k = 30000) passes L and T but varies by 0.3 > 0.25.
No fit under the variable policy: one record failing each variable test first (counts 1 each). Cases +10 mm (design) and +20 mm. The constant record is not tested and is not counted.
L boundary passes: W = 1024, k = 8192, u_D = 1/16 m, a = 1/128 m, hot. Envelope [960, 1600] N equals VS-LEQ's range exactly; VS-LOVER (F_max 1599.5) fails L.
T boundary passes: required travel 1/16 + 2/128 = 0.078125 m equals VS-TEQ's travel range; VS-TSHORT (0.078 m) fails T.
V boundary passes: operating-load variation 512/1024 = 0.5 equals the limit; VS-8200 varies by 512.5/1024 and fails V.

Constant boundaries pass: W = 1024 equals CE-MIN's F_min (whose travel range equals the required 0.078125 m) and CE-MAX's F_max; both fit and smallest capacity picks CE-MAX. CE-OVER fails L, CE-SHORT fails T.
smallest_capacity decided by F_max: VS-A (F_max 1300, v 0.2) beats VS-B (1500, v 0.05) and VS-C (2000).
smallest_capacity tie on F_max (1500) broken by max variation: VS-B (v 0.05) beats VS-A (0.2); VS-C has F_max 1600.
smallest_capacity tie on F_max and variation broken by hanger_id byte order: 'VS-10' < 'VS-9' < 'vs-1'.
least_variation decided by variation: VS-B (v 0.05) beats VS-C (smaller F_max 1200, v 0.1) and VS-A (v 0.2).
least_variation tie on variation (k = 5000) broken by F_max: VS-B (1400) beats VS-A (1600).
least_variation tie on variation and F_max broken by hanger_id byte order: 'VS-B10' < 'VS-B2'.
Constant policy under least_variation: constant variation is 0, so the rule reduces to F_max then hanger_id; 'CE-10' < 'CE-2' at F_max 1500. The variable record is not tested.
Fallback taken: variable_else_constant, no variable record fits (T, V), so constants are tested; CE-SMALL fails L and CE-1 is selected by fallback.
Fallback not needed: variable_else_constant, VS-OK fits, so constants are not tested and only variable counts are reported.
No fit under the constant policy: CE-NORANGE fails E1, CE-SMALL fails L, CE-SHORT fails T.
No fit under variable_else_constant: VS-V fails V, the fallback is tried and CE-SMALL fails L; both families' counts are reported.
R-3b: two of three candidates have W <= 0 (H-3 at -250 N, H-2 at 0 N). The request is refused, naming them in input order; no candidate is sized.

Verification of a variable selection, passing: cold design, design-load variation, allowance 1 mm. Sized F_cold = 2010; verified u_C^v = 0.5 mm, u^v = (11.5, 6.5) mm give F_C^v = 2005, departure +5 N, v^v = (0.055, 0.03).

Verification of a variable selection failing L and V: hot design, sized F_cold = 1100. Verified u_C^v = -2 mm, u_D^v = 16 mm give F_D^v = 940 (envelope low end 940 < 950) and v^v = 180/940 > 0.15; departure -60 N.
Verification of a variable selection failing V0, L and V with the design-load reference (so the variation stays defined): verified u_D^v = 120 mm gives F_D^v = -100 N; T passes.

R-4b mixed verification in SI. Stiffness [[2, -1], [-1, 1]] N/mm. A is variable (k = 2 N/mm = 2000 N/m, hot setting 120 N, W = 100 N); B is constant (W = 100 N, 5 mm travel range). Sizing positions u_C = (0, 0), u_D = (10, 0) mm; verified u_C^v = (20/3, 20/3) mm, u_D^v = (10, 0) mm; a = 1 mm. A: F_C^v = 320/3 N, v^v = 1/15 (6.667 %), departure 0, passes. B: verified required travel 26/3 mm > 5 mm, fails T.
Verification standing conditional: H-HEAVY (W = 5000 N) has no fitting record and gets no verification block; H-OK is verified and passes.

Verified operating load exactly 0 under operating_load (binary64-exact): hot design, W = 1024, k = 8192, u_D = 1/16 m, so F_cold = 1536. Verified u_D^v = 3/16 m gives F_D^v = 0: no ratio is formed (variation [null]); V0 and L fail, T passes, and V is not failed because no ratio is formed. Departure -1024 N.

Verified operating load negative under operating_load (the section 7 witness): hot design, W = 1000, k = 10000, u_C = 0, u_D = 10 mm, so F_cold = 1100. Verified u_D^v = 120 mm gives F_D^v = -100 N: variation [null]; V0 and L fail, T passes, V is not failed. Departure -1100 N.

Mixed absent and formed verified ratios, formed ratio passing: hot design, operating_load, W = 1000, k = 10000, cases +10 mm (design) and +20 mm, F_cold = 1100. Verified u^v = (12, 150) mm give F^v = (980, -400) N: variation [120/980, null]; 6/49 <= 0.25 so V passes; V0 and L fail, T passes. Departure -20 N.

Mixed absent and formed verified ratios, formed ratio failing V: cold design, operating_load, W = 1000, k = 10000, u_C = 0, cases +10 and +20 mm, F_cold = 1000. Verified u_C^v = 1 mm, u^v = (50, 120) mm give F_C^v = 990, F^v = (500, -200) N: variation [490/500, null]; 0.98 > 0.3 fails V; V0 and L also fail, T passes. Departure (cold) -10 N.

design_index 1, hot design: W = 1000, k = 10000, u_C = 0, u_operating = (10, 20) mm with the design case at index 1, so F_cold = W + k*u_D = 1200 (not 1100), F = (1100, 1000), envelope [1000, 1200] N, variation (1/11, 0.2). VS-DI fits; VS-IDX0 (range [850, 1150]) would fit only if F_cold were read from index 0, and fails L.

design_index 1 in verification, hot design: W = 1000, k = 10000, u_operating = (-5, 10) mm with the design case at index 1, F_cold = 1100. Verified u_C^v = 1 mm, u^v = (-4, 12) mm give F_C^v = 1090, F^v = (1140, 980) N; the departure F_D^v - W reads index 1: -20 N (index 0 would give +140 N). All tests pass.
